topicName: Deep Dive into git log: Options and Formatting
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Deep Dive into git log: Options and Formatting"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The 'git log' command is a powerful tool for exploring the history of a Git repository. It allows you to view commit messages, authors, dates, and changes made over time. This tutorial will delve into various options and formatting techniques to effectively utilize 'git log'."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Basic Usage"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"The simplest form of the command is just 'git log'. This will display the commit history in reverse chronological order, showing the commit hash, author, date, and commit message for each commit."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"git log"},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"Filtering Commits"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"Git provides several options to filter the commit history based on different criteria:"},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--author: Filter by author. Example: 'git log --author=\"John Doe\"'"},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"git log --author=\"John Doe\""},{"order":10,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--committer: Filter by committer. Example: 'git log --committer=\"John Doe\"'"},{"order":11,"type":"code","text":"git log --committer=\"John Doe\""},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--grep: Filter by commit message content. Example: 'git log --grep=\"Fix bug\"'"},{"order":13,"type":"code","text":"git log --grep=\"Fix bug\""},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--before/--after: Filter by date. Example: 'git log --before=\"2023-01-01\" --after=\"2022-12-01\"'"},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"git log --before=\"2023-01-01\" --after=\"2022-12-01\""},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"-n <number>: Limit the number of commits displayed. Example: 'git log -n 5'"},{"order":17,"type":"code","text":"git log -n 5"},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--since/--until: Similar to --before/--after, but more human-readable. Example: 'git log --since=\"1 week ago\"'"},{"order":19,"type":"code","text":"git log --since=\"1 week ago\""},{"order":20,"type":"subheading","text":"Formatting the Output"},{"order":21,"type":"paragraph","text":"Git offers various options to customize the output format of 'git log'."},{"order":22,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--oneline: Displays each commit on a single line. Example: 'git log --oneline'"},{"order":23,"type":"code","text":"git log --oneline"},{"order":24,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--graph: Displays an ASCII graph of the branch structure. Example: 'git log --graph'"},{"order":25,"type":"code","text":"git log --graph"},{"order":26,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--decorate: Shows branch and tag names that point to the commits. Example: 'git log --decorate'"},{"order":27,"type":"code","text":"git log --decorate"},{"order":28,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--pretty: Allows for custom formatting using placeholders. Example: 'git log --pretty=\"format:%h %an %ad %s\"'"},{"order":29,"type":"code","text":"git log --pretty=\"format:%h %an %ad %s\""},{"order":30,"type":"paragraph","text":"Common placeholders for '--pretty=format:' include:"},{"order":31,"type":"bullet_point","text":"%h: Abbreviated commit hash"},{"order":32,"type":"bullet_point","text":"%H: Full commit hash"},{"order":33,"type":"bullet_point","text":"%an: Author name"},{"order":34,"type":"bullet_point","text":"%ae: Author email"},{"order":35,"type":"bullet_point","text":"%ad: Author date (use --date=format:<format> for custom date formatting)"},{"order":36,"type":"bullet_point","text":"%s: Commit subject"},{"order":37,"type":"bullet_point","text":"%b: Commit body"},{"order":38,"type":"subheading","text":"Viewing Diffs"},{"order":39,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can view the changes introduced by each commit directly in the log output."},{"order":40,"type":"bullet_point","text":"-p: Shows the patch (diff) for each commit. Example: 'git log -p'"},{"order":41,"type":"code","text":"git log -p"},{"order":42,"type":"bullet_point","text":"--stat: Shows statistics about the files modified in each commit. Example: 'git log --stat'"},{"order":43,"type":"code","text":"git log --stat"},{"order":44,"type":"subheading","text":"Combining Options"},{"order":45,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can combine multiple options to create powerful and specific log queries. For example, to view the last 5 commits by John Doe with the word \"bug\" in the commit message, showing the diff for each commit, you would use:"},{"order":46,"type":"code","text":"git log -n 5 --author=\"John Doe\" --grep=\"bug\" -p"},{"order":47,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":48,"type":"paragraph","text":"'git log' is a versatile command with numerous options for filtering, formatting, and displaying commit history. Mastering these options will significantly improve your ability to understand and navigate your Git repository."}]
